body.en: Structural phase fasteners are load-bearing and critical to building safety: Anchor bolts (J-bolts, L-bolts) — M20/M24 for column base plates; embed in concrete during pour; specify HDG or 316 SS for coastal; quantity = 4 per column minimum. Structural hex bolts — M16/M20 Grade 10.9 for beam-to-column, beam-to-beam connections; specify HDG for outdoor exposed; quantity = per connection design (typically 4-8 per splice). Base plate shims — thin steel plates for leveling steel columns before grouting; size to match base plate. Shear studs — M19×100 Nelson studs for composite steel-deck floors; welded to beam flanges before deck installation. High-strength F1554 Grade 55 or 105 for anchor bolts in seismic zones. 屋面紧固件必须抵抗风吸力并提供防水密封：IBR/梯形屋面螺丝 — #3钻尖，六角头配EPDM垫圈；6mm（用于0.5mm板）或8mm（用于0.8mm板）钻尖；数量：屋面4-6个/m²，墙面6-8个/m²；务必根据风区计算。侧搭接螺丝 — #2钻尖，盘头，50mm长；每个搭接肋500mm间距一颗。脊帽螺丝 — 与屋面螺丝相同；在脊的两侧安装。泛水钉 — 环纹钉用于固定泛水；热浸镀锌。沿海地区（距海洋10km以内）应指定不锈钢304屋面螺丝。对于颜色匹配的板，应指定正确RAL颜色的聚合物涂层 — 通常500小时以上盐雾耐受性。
覆层螺丝系统与屋面螺丝类似，但根据应用有所不同：保温板固定螺丝 — 自攻螺丝配合垫圈，用于固定岩棉或玻璃棉保温层；长度应根据保温层厚度选择，通常为50-150mm。覆层搭接螺丝 — 型号与侧搭接螺丝相同，确保板与板之间的紧密连接。端部搭接螺丝 — 用于固定板端部搭接，间距通常为300mm。
泛水与收边系统需要专用紧固件：泛水板固定钉 — 不锈钢或热浸镀锌钉，间距150-200mm；收边条螺丝 — 六角头自攻螺丝，长度根据收边条厚度选择。雨水槽固定螺丝 — 不锈钢螺丝，用于固定雨水槽吊件，间距不超过600mm。
安装注意事项：1）钻孔直径应比螺丝直径大0.5-1mm，以确保螺丝顺利穿透；2）EPDM垫圈应在螺丝紧固后完全压紧，但不得过度压缩；3）对于双层屋面系统，上下层应使用不同长度的螺丝，以避免热桥；4）在高风压区域，应增加螺丝密度或使用抗风夹。

body.fr: Les fixations de toiture doivent résister à l'arrachement par le vent et assurer l'étanchéité : Vis de toiture IBR/Trapèze — pointe forêt n°3, tête hexagonale avec rondelle EPDM ; pointe de 6 mm (pour tôle de 0,5 mm) ou 8 mm (pour tôle de 0,8 mm) ; quantité = 4-6 par m² pour les toitures, 6-8 par m² pour les parois ; toujours calculer en fonction de la zone de vent. Vis de recouvrement latéral — pointe forêt n°2, tête cylindrique bombée, 50 mm de longueur ; une par nervure de recouvrement à intervalles de 500 mm. Vis de faîtière — identiques aux vis de toiture ; à poser des deux côtés du faîtage. Clous de solin — clous à tige annelée pour la fixation des solins ; galvanisés à chaud. Pour les zones côtières (dans un rayon de 10 km de l'océan), spécifier des vis de toiture en acier inoxydable 304. Pour les tôles prélaquées, spécifier un revêtement polymère dans le bon RAL — typiquement résistance au brouillard salin supérieure à 500 heures. Un approvisionnement fondé sur les normes exige un apprentissage continu, car les normes ISO, ASTM, DIN et GB sont révisées tous les 3 à 5 ans. Abonnez-vous aux notifications de mise à jour des normes et passez en revue vos spécifications chaque année. body.en: For estimating fastener quantities at construction planning stage: Rule of thumb — allow 25-40kg of mixed fasteners per 100m² of building (excluding structural steel). For roofing — allow 6-8 screws per m² of IBR roof sheeting (depending on wind zone); for cladding allow 8-10 per m². For drywall — allow approximately 1 kg of drywall screws per 10m² of drywall. For electrical — allow approximately 1 bag (500g) of wall plugs per 50m²; plus 1 box of cable clips per 100m² of building. These are estimates only — always verify against actual project specifications and structural engineer's requirements. For B2B buyers operating in multiple countries, harmonize specifications with regional standards and local customs requirements. Common regional frameworks: SABS (South Africa), KEBS (Kenya), TBS (Tanzania), ZIMRA (Zimbabwe), SON (Nigeria), and AfCFTA standards for pan-Africa trade. faqItems.q: What is the rough-in phase in construction?
faqItems.a: Rough-in is the construction phase after structural work but before finishing. It involves installing hidden components like electrical wiring, plumbing pipes, HVAC ducts, and their mounting fasteners.

faqItems.q: What fasteners are needed for structural steel connection?
faqItems.a: High-strength bolts (Grade 8.8 or 10.9), bearing-type bolted connections, and specified torque values. Hot-dip galvanized bolts are preferred for outdoor or corrosive environments.

faqItems.q: Which fasteners are required for roofing and cladding?
faqItems.a: Self-drilling roofing screws with EPDM washers, standing seam clips, clad pins, and stitching screws. Material thickness determines the required screw gauge and length.

faqItems.q: How many phases does the construction rough-in include?
faqItems.a: The rough-in process typically spans 5 phases: structural steel connection, roofing and cladding, ceiling and partition installation, electrical and plumbing rough-in, and finishing work.

faqItems.q: What fasteners are used in the finishing phase?
faqItems.a: Finishing phase uses drywall screws, trim nails, finish nails, deck screws, and miscellaneous hardware for fixtures, millwork, and final building components.
